observations: Photo 0: A rectangular solar panel with many small cells; brand/model text on the frame is not clearly readable; there is glare from a light reflection.
Photo 1: Another front view of the same solar panel; the frame has a watermark-style text overlay, but no clear wattage/model is readable.

claims.claim: Thank you for contacting Network Solar venture Please let us know how we can help you. We deal...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not confirm what they deal in or the specific item rating.

risks.risk: Wattage/brand/model is not readable from the photos, so the panel could be lower or higher than the comparable list assumes.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the panel’s label/sticker (usually on the frame back) showing brand, model, and rated wattage (W), plus serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case match among the comparables (i.e., treat it as a lower-watt used panel rather than a higher-watt premium one).

risks.risk: Condition/health (degradation, micro-cracks, damaged cells) cannot be confirmed from glare photos.
risks.proof: A short video while tilting the panel under light to show any cracked cells, plus an IV test report or multimeter reading of open-circuit voltage (Voc) and short-circuit current (Isc).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed (assume reduced performance) until an IV test or clear cell condition is shown.

risks.risk: Compatibility/connector type and wiring condition (loose terminals, damaged junction box) is not verifiable from the back photos.
risks.proof: Close-up of the junction box and terminal area, showing no burn marks and the exact connector type; include a photo of the cable ends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing basic checking/possible minor repair.

risks.risk: The photos may not correspond to the exact wattage being sold (mismatch risk).
risks.proof: Photo of the label with the same watermark/date visible, or a photo of the label next to a handwritten note with today’s date and the seller’s name.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used solar panel without confirmed rating.

proof_requests: Close-up of the panel’s rating label/sticker (brand + model + rated wattage in W + serial number).
IV test report (or at least Voc/Isc readings) taken in sunlight or under standard test conditions.
Close-up of the junction box/terminal area and the exact connector type/cable ends.
response.reason: The item is clearly a solar panel, but the key pricing driver (rated wattage/brand/model) is not readable in the provided photos, so a worst-case price pick from the comparables would be guesswork.
